description: A stereo distortion whose gain, bias and wavefolding follow the phase of the moon, taken from the computer clock or set by hand

params.text: Sets the phase by hand, a full turn being one lunar month; it does nothing while the switch is on Auto
Sets how hard the moon leans on the signal: at the new moon it stays nearly clean whatever this is set to, and at the full moon it reaches saturation and wavefolding
Blends the distorted signal against the clean one
Chooses where the phase comes from: Manual, from the knob and the CV jack, or Auto, from the computer clock

inputs.text: Moves the phase, 10V being one whole lunar cycle, and it does nothing while the switch is on Auto
The left channel in, which also feeds the right channel when the jack beside it is empty

outputs.text: The distorted left channel; with the right output unpatched this jack carries the two channels summed to mono

notes: waxing phases bias the shaper one way and waning phases the other, so the two halves of the month sound different at the same brightness
the panel draws the moon at the phase in use, with its name under it

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.2:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the jack beside it.
